summary: Retained for retrospective model-development research and agent evaluation with the labeled eval split. Each row is one care-home location active on the CQC register at a January 'HSCA Active Locations' vintage instant T (selected by the vintage's own 'Care home?' = Y column read at T; the label is looked up afterwards, solely to compute the label). Features are the vintage's own at-T columns; as-of was asserted in-build (0/14,765 eval rows carry a rating publication date after T). The prediction instant is the vintage production instant (period_end, administrative record, 0-day lag). The evaluation contract is retrospective research with isolated rows: identity ships as per-instant salted pseudonyms (the missing-successor P0 design - each scored frame carries a single instant), so no prior-instant outcome is linkable and there is NO persistence reference by design; gate cross-row probes measured pseudonym-successor coverage 0/0/0 on train/eval/holdout and quasi-identifier (LA x beds x start-year x rating x sector) coverage 0 on eval and holdout (11,786 on train, where labels are public anyway). Training-label timing is UNVERIFIED - the Google Drive archive serves the historical active-locations vintages but no full-row availability ledger exists for them, and the label register is the current cumulative 2026-11-02 deactivated edition - so no historical-forecasting or operational claim is made. Measured finding carried beside every figure: the stock runner baseline scored eval AUC 0.5659 (both runner implementations agree) on the identical 14,765 eval rows, BELOW the strongest reference rating_x_beds_rate 0.5871 (train-fitted rate table over latest rating x beds; paired bootstrap over last_rating_rate 0.5597 with CI95 [0.0123, 0.0407] excluding zero) but ABOVE every one-line prior - a recorded defect of the stock runner under this protocol, not a no-headroom verdict: the reference reads only shipped at-T columns (no information asymmetry), so any consumer can compute it in one line and beating it is the natural target for a solver. One verified diagnosis candidate: the stock train.py treats 'instant' (YYYY-MM) as a train-only categorical, so the eval instant 2024-01 is unseen. Majority-class accuracy on eval is 0.94873 (no ranking information). Framing limitation stated everywhere: the target is the register event (deregistration), which CQC's own file note says can include services continuing under a new registration - not necessarily service cessation (BMJ Public Health 2024 implies ~40-55% re-registrations/transfers).

cross_row_audit.scope: Gate 1.5.0's own probes over the full artifact (job cqc-chd-004, checks contract.cross_row_probe_0 and contract.cross_row_probe_1): the pseudonym-successor join covers 0 train / 0 eval / 0 holdout rows, and the strongest instant-invariant quasi-key join (LA x beds x start-year x rating x sector, +12-month offset) covers 0 eval and 0 holdout rows (11,786 train rows, where labels are public anyway). Each scored frame carries a SINGLE instant (train 2018-01..2022-01, eval 2024-01, holdout 2025-01), so successor rows of eval rows exist only in the sealed holdout and holdout rows have no successor instant in the artifact. Isolated rows remain the declared requirement; the probes are a measured bound, not an enforcement claim.

limitations: Training-label timing and full-row historical availability are UNVERIFIED: the pinned January vintages are genuine historical register snapshots, but no availability ledger exists for the 2011-2026 Drive archive and the label register is the current cumulative deactivated edition (2026-11-02, max observed end date 2026-10-27, holdout window end 2026-01-01, margin 299 days). No point-in-time reconstruction or operational availability is claimed.

Framing: the target is the register event (deregistration), which conflates cessation with re-registration (CQC in-file note; BMJ Public Health 2024 implies ~40-55% re-registrations/transfers). Successor linkage needs developer-portal API access and was not built.

The stock runner baseline (0.5659) trails the strongest reference (rating_x_beds_rate 0.5871) on the identical eval rows - a recorded defect of that runner under this protocol; no model above the reference has been measured and fitting until a score wins is not the protocol.

Era breaks inside the train-to-eval span: the single-assessment rating change (~2024) and the 1 April 2019 regulatory-history inheritance change; the publisher's system migration delays reflection of recent cancellations in current files (lag measured, margin 299 days).
One eval instant and one holdout instant (January 2024 / January 2025): the measured comparison covers a single instant each, not a range of instants.
supported_uses: Retrospective research and method comparison on the pinned artifact afe9ee203f302f3c, predicting row-wise from the shipped at-T vintage columns under an isolated-rows protocol, with the labeled eval split as development/validation

Agent evaluation with the labeled eval split: the consumer (a coding agent) edits the runner's train.py; the recorded reference ladder (rating_x_beds_rate 0.5871 leading) is the target to beat and must be quoted beside any model figure
Reproducibility studies: every artifact file is digest-pinned, the construction source bytes are sha256-pinned, and the gate, references and baseline are all shipped in the package
unsupported_uses: Operational or live deregistration-risk screening claims: no historical operational-availability evidence exists and none is claimed
Point-in-time historical reconstruction of the label register beyond the pinned edition, or any claim that the cumulative deactivated file's state equals the file's state at past instants
Reading the model-vs-reference comparison as a ceiling: the stock runner trailing rating_x_beds_rate does not prove every competent model must lose, and no model above the reference has been measured
Quoting any single figure from this dataset without the comparison ladder and the register-event framing limitation beside it
Service-closure prediction: the label is the register event, not verified cessation
required_actions: Before any evaluation: read the evaluation contract in release/cqc-care-home-deregistration/quality.json; treat the labeled eval split as development/validation and keep the holdout outside evaluated agents' workspaces until a design is frozen

Any evaluated model figure must be quoted beside rating_x_beds_rate 0.5871 on the identical eval rows, with the no-persistence-by-design note and the majority-class accuracy 0.94873 (no ranking information)
Holdout (14,749 rows / 761 positives) stays sealed until the design is frozen; a holdout score requires a pre-registered protocol and is final, never development
Consumers must keep the CQC attribution statement and the derived-labelling notice in every redistribution (OGL-UK v3.0 terms preserved; see release/cqc-care-home-deregistration/LICENSE.md)
